relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1β and TNF-α levels, and BDNF and TrkB protein expression in the spinal dorsal horn were decreased

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: EA could alleviate pain symptoms in rats with PHN, possibly by regulating the BDNF/TrkB pathway, inhibiting microglial activation in the spinal dorsal horn, and reducing inflammatory factor levels.

key_findings: In PHN rats, electroacupuncture reduced dorsal horn BDNF/TrkB expression, Iba-1 microglial activation, IL-1beta and TNF-alpha and relieved pain behaviour
Intrathecal BDNF blunted the effect of electroacupuncture
